name: Latent-NeRF
definition: Applies score distillation to a latent diffusion model and the compact latent space of a pre-trained autoencoder to optimize NeRF.
summary: Latent-NeRF renders 2D feature maps in a pretrained autoencoder's latent space rather than RGB, enabling powerful 2D image priors for 3D consistency while avoiding the cost of encoding rendered images.
